orders_fulfilment_check.name: orders_fulfilment_check
orders_fulfilment_check.value: ("orders"."fulfilment_method" = 'delivery' and "orders"."shipping_address" is not null) or ("orders"."fulfilment_method" = 'click_and_collect' and "orders"."collection_store_id" is not null)

payouts_bank_details_check.name: payouts_bank_details_check
payouts_bank_details_check.value: "payouts"."method" <> 'bank_transfer' or ("payouts"."account_holder_name_encrypted" is not null and "payouts"."sort_code_encrypted" is not null and "payouts"."account_number_encrypted" is not null and "payouts"."account_number_last4" is not null)

quotes_drop_off_store_check.name: quotes_drop_off_store_check
quotes_drop_off_store_check.value: "quotes"."delivery_method" is distinct from 'store_drop_off' or "quotes"."drop_off_store_id" is not null

quotes_declarations_check.name: quotes_declarations_check
quotes_declarations_check.value: "quotes"."status" in ('offered', 'expired', 'cancelled') or ("quotes"."ownership_declared_at" is not null and "quotes"."activation_lock_off_declared_at" is not null and "quotes"."contact_email" is not null)

quotes_accepted_check.name: quotes_accepted_check
quotes_accepted_check.value: "quotes"."status" in ('offered', 'expired', 'cancelled') or ("quotes"."customer_id" is not null and "quotes"."delivery_method" is not null)
